entry.title: New: dsh-agentmail
entry.summary: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound. Exact install spec: dsh-agentmail. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
